rationale: Before mitigation: 9 of 10 measurements (90%) fall within the normal band [0.90, 1.10] pu, below the 95% requirement. One measurement at t03 (0.889 pu) is below the normal lower limit. A tap correction of +0.025 pu shifts all voltages upward, bringing t03 to 0.914 pu (within normal band) and keeping all other measurements within absolute limits [0.85, 1.10] pu. This achieves 100% compliance with the normal band requirement.
